missing.why: Levi was still in Abraham's loins when Melchizedek met Abraham, identifying Abraham as his forefather.
The text says that our Lord sprang from Judah (ἐξ Ἰούδα ἀνατέταλκεν).
Melchizedek is likened to the Son of God, whom the chapter identifies as Jesus.

note: Abraham is called Levi's father in the ancestral sense; the chapter gives no intervening genealogy.
